_doc: People passing time on the pier (11/11). The rope rails between the posts are 78 cm tall, too low to lean on (the UAL 2 Idle_Rail clip holds the wrists 92-95 cm up, 6-20 cm in front): one person leans on the timber guard rail at the sea end of the platform (mare_pier.rail: top 93 cm, 13 cm in front of the spot), one watches the sea with the arms folded and one talks on the phone. spots: [x, y, deck z, yaw, clip]. They come and go only while the player is 25 m away.
